docs: Instruction data is the Borsh BridgeInstruction enum: one-byte discriminant followed by fields in declaration order.
Account state begins with a one-byte BridgeAccount discriminator followed by its derived inner payload; fixed allocation padding is not a logical field.
Retired numbers are never reused: discriminants 0-3 and 10-13, account tags 1-6 and event tags 1-3 and 10-12 belong to the legacy program and are absent here.
A route binds one source asset to one registered receipt mint under a nonzero u32 route id. Withdrawals escrow the route's receipt mint until an authorized finalize or reject transition.
A bare amount, min_withdrawal_amount, withdrawal_fee or supply_limit is in receipt base units; source_amount is in source base units.
Events are bounded observability hints; canonical PDAs are authoritative.

metadata.description: PropAMM signed-quote AMM with config-PDA vault custody. Native Borsh tags: InitializeConfig=0, CreateVault=1, ExecuteTrade=2, UpdateQuoteSigner=3, WithdrawVault=4, UpdateSkewRatio=5. ExecuteTrade carries compact quote terms, actual input amount, and optional taker minimum output; user and mint keys come from signed instruction accounts. Config v3 appends a skew multiplier; v2 defaults to 10000 bps and migrates in place on UpdateSkewRatio.
metadata.name: PropAMM

docs: One to three sequential steps; each hop consumes only the previous hop credit. The minimum is net final output since the route began.
RouteStepsV1 encodes the one-byte step count as an enum tag, followed by a fixed array. There is no u32 vector length.
After user and token_program, remaining accounts are step_count + 1 (mint, writable user ATA) pairs, then one venue group per step. All route mints and user ATAs must be distinct.
VaultMint group (6): vault_program, vault, reserve, protocol_fee_recipient_ata, manager_fee_recipient_ata, event_authority. The output share mint must be writable.

VaultRedeem group (9): vault_program, vault, reserve, escrow, redeem_entry, protocol_fee_recipient_ata, manager_fee_recipient_ata, event_authority, system_program. The input share mint must be writable.
ClammSwap group (8 + supplemental count): clamm_program, pool, pool_token_vault_a, pool_token_vault_b, tick_array_0, tick_array_1, tick_array_2, oracle, followed by supplemental tick arrays.

PropAmmSwap group (7): propamm_program, config, signing maker, writable user_nonce, writable base_vault, writable quote_vault, system_program. Buy spends quote and receives base; Sell spends base and receives quote. The native CPI receives the unchanged quote, measured hop input, and explicit min_out = 0; the router enforces the final minimum.

After all venue groups, optional trailer (2): associated_token_program, system_program, both read-only. When supplied, the user pays for idempotent creation of missing canonical user ATAs before balance snapshots. Existing valid ATAs are preserved; without the trailer all user ATAs must already exist. Venue accounts are not created by the router.
Mint and Redeem must fill immediately; amounts, minimum and deadline are checked by the program. Successful return data is RouteResultV1 with version 1.
instructions.name: route_exact_in_v1

limitations: Service health/config is its public effective view; raw TOML path, key filename, pricing-engine URL and enabled router bindings are not exposed.
Published IDL equality is ABI evidence, not an ELF-to-source reproducible-build attestation. ELF hashes record observed deployed binaries.
Existing receipt state is read-only evidence; no fresh signing, co-signing, swap submission or replay attempt was performed.
